candidates.explanation: Clear, coherent capability colocation; framework-neutral generation operation; capability-shaped provider port; Route Handler SSE lifecycle with upstream abort propagation, sliding idle timeout, and pre-/post-commit failure handling; channel-native HTTP, stream, and job outcomes sharing semantic failure/reporting primitives; no provider text or SDK types leak into public/domain contracts. None of the negative patterns is present.

Clear, coherent single-capability architecture with justified runtime surfaces; provider-neutral application policy and capability-shaped port; correct Route Handler/SSE commit discipline, cancellation propagation, sliding idle timeout, and in-band post-commit errors; native HTTP, stream, and job contracts share semantic classification, redaction, and report-once behavior; provider details remain private to the adapter. None of the negative patterns is present.
